analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($708.84) vs SMA5 ($731.08)/SMA20 ($742.47)/SMA50 ($726.31): below all, indicating weakening short-term and mid-term trend.
· Below SMA100 ($719.99), above SMA200 ($673.66): mixed long-term trend.
· 52-week position (73.9%) + current price level in a pullback phase historically.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (61.0→34.8): confirmed entry into oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.8433→-4.7275): continued worsening, confirming bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $720.09): approaching lower band, with band width narrowing to 6.03%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($704.66): close to 5-day low ($707.23), above Pivot S1 ($689.76).
· Swing resistance ($721.89): below SMA50 ($726.31) and Pivot PP ($726.31).
· 5-day high/low pattern: simultaneous Higher Low and Lower High, suggesting potential for a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.53x): recent moves have gained traction, but trend reversal signals are weak.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach due to lack of directional bias.
